notes.title: TurretCraft Updated
notes.content:
Hey there!

We published an update to fix some issues, and improve a few things.

Here are what has changed:


    Two bugs fixed about turret placing.
    Practice mode fixed.
    Turret race picking window now tells to pick one. :)
    Hotkeys are always shown now. In previous version you had to press ALT.
    When Turret limit (Blue Gem) is reached, there is a visual sign to upgrade the limit.


More improvements and changes are on the way. 

Enjoy!
